pageCache.pageTitle: Message from the Headteacher - St Mark's C of E Primary School
pageCache.text:
Message from the Headteacher
Welcome to our website!
I am delighted to welcome you to our vibrant and friendly school community here at St. Marks. As the Headteacher, with over 20 years of experience at St. Marks and a career spent in Islington, I am incredibly proud of the positive environment and strong values that define our school.
At St. Marks, we are a popular and oversubscribed inner-city school serving children aged 2-11 years old. Our one-form entry approach means we know each child personally and provide a nurturing and inclusive atmosphere. As a Church of England school, our Christian values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we treat each other with respect and kindness. Our dedicated team of teachers and staff are passionate about making learning exciting and fun. We offer creative and challenging experiences that help children grow and develop both inside and outside the classroom. Our students regularly participate in a variety of activities and events, which enrich their learning and help them build confidence. We are supported by a committed Governing Body that works closely with us to ensure we are always striving to improve. We embrace new and innovative practices to provide the best possible education for our children. Our focus on “holistic development” and “evidence-based strategies” helps us create a dynamic and effective learning environment.
At St. Marks, our motto is ‘Every Child, Every Chance, Every Day.’ This reflects our dedication to giving each child the support and opportunities they need to succeed. We believe that a safe, happy, and engaging learning environment is key to helping our students thrive. Thank you for visiting our website. I encourage you to explore and discover more about our wonderful school. We look forward to welcoming you and sharing the exciting journey of learning and growth that makes St. Marks such a special place. Warm regards,
Year Groups

Our Christian Values
At St. Mark’s, our Christian values form the foundation of everything we do. Rooted in the teachings of Jesus Christ, these values –
Creation, Hope, Thankfulness, Friendship, Endurance, Justice, Trust, Koinonia, and Wisdom
-guide our community and shape the spiritual development of every student. These principles reflect the legacy Jesus left for us: the call to create and nurture, to hold onto hope, to express gratitude, to build lasting friendships, to persevere, to seek justice, to place our trust in God, to foster community (koinonia), and to seek wisdom in all things.
These values are integral to the spiritual nourishment of our school and enable us to grow in faith and character. Our vision is anchored in the scripture, “Thy word is a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path” (Psalm 119:105).
Just as God’s word illuminates our way, these values serve as a guiding light, helping us navigate life with purpose and integrity in a Church of England (CofE) school.

Our Christian Vision
Summary statement of our Christian Vision
Our Vision: Illuminating Lives Through God’s Word
At the heart of our vision is a profound Christian understanding of God, revealed through His Word in both the Old and New Testaments and exemplified in the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. Psalm 119 beautifully captures the essence of God’s Word, portraying attributes that reflect God’s very nature: righteousness, trustworthiness, truthfulness, faithfulness, unchangeability, eternality, light, and purity.
Empowering Individuals, Enriching Community
Our vision is deeply rooted in the belief that each person is precious to God and uniquely crafted with a purpose. As we journey through life, we are guided by God’s Word, which lights our path and directs us towards a future brimming with promise and potential. We are not alone on this journey; God walks with us, fostering an environment where every individual and community can thrive.
Fostering Flourishing Through Faith
Our commitment to this vision is evident in every decision we make, ensuring that our actions reflect the values of God’s Word. We are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards in all aspects of our lives, creating a safe and nurturing environment where every child feels valued and empowered to achieve their best. Our approach ensures that children grow in confidence and are equipped to navigate their journey with success.
A Vibrant Curriculum That Inspires
Our curriculum is a living expression of our vision, crafted to inspire and engage every student. It reflects our Christian ethos, celebrating the richness of our faith while providing a robust, creative educational experience. Through rigorous monitoring and evaluation, we continuously assess the impact of our work, ensuring that our curriculum aligns with our Christian values and meets the distinctiveness required by the SIAMS framework.
Journeying Together in Faith and Excellence
In all that we do, our vision guides us to create a vibrant, supportive community where faith and learning go hand in hand. We embrace our responsibilities to each other and to the world, journeying together towards a future where every individual can flourish in the light of God’s love.

Every Child, Every Chance, Every Day!
At St. Mark’s, we believe in the power of vision to shape not only the minds but also the hearts of our children. Each academic year, we center our school community around a key strand of our overarching vision, weaving this theme into every aspect of learning and life at school. Through meaningful discussions, hands-on projects, and engagement with current events—whether local, national, or global—our students develop a deep understanding of the world around them and their place within it.
Embedding these strands is a vital part of life at St. Mark’s, as they help provide our children with the cultural capital they need to grow into informed, compassionate, and active global citizens. In 2023-24, we embraced the theme, “Together we will guide you towards a fulfilling future.” This focus encouraged our students to think critically about the health of the planet and their responsibility to it. We reimagined our learning spaces, renaming classes and biomes to reflect the importance of the natural world, and engaged our children in dynamic discussions and projects focused on climate change. The children explored the essential truth that a fulfilling future can only be achieved through the protection and preservation of a healthy environment. Their journey was rich with discovery, teamwork, and creativity as they explored how their actions can shape the future of the planet.
Click the link below to discover the incredible ways our students worked on this important focus and shared their learning with the whole school community.
As we look ahead to the coming year, we are excited to embark on a new strand: “Together we will teach you to live within the value of God’s word.” This year, each class will be assigned a specific Christian value—such as trust, wisdom, or justice—and will have the opportunity to explore and demonstrate how these values reflect the teachings of Jesus and enrich our lives. The entire St. Mark’s community will come together to learn from one another, growing in faith and understanding.
We can’t wait to see how each class will inspire the school with their projects, lessons, and creative expressions of their chosen value. Stay tuned to our regularly updated news section for weekly highlights and exciting updates on the wonderful things happening here at St. Mark’s as we continue to grow in faith, knowledge, and community.

What St. Mark’s Promises your Child
At St. Marks, our vision is inspired by the words of Psalm 119: “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path.” This beautiful verse guides us in everything we do and helps us shape our promise to each child who joins our school community. We offer our children a unique and enriching experience through five key promises that radiate from our vision:
1. Together, We Will Prepare You for Life and Learning – We equip each child with the skills and knowledge they need to thrive both now and in the future. Our broad and rich curriculum is designed to spark curiosity and build a solid foundation for lifelong learning.
2. Together, We Will Teach You to Live Within the Values of God’s Word – Our Christian values are at the heart of our school. We guide our children to live with kindness, respect, and integrity, helping them understand and embody the teachings of God’s word in their daily lives.
3.Together, We Will Lead You Safely on Your Journey – We ensure a safe and supportive environment where every child feels secure and valued. Our caring staff are here to lead and support each child as they navigate their learning journey with confidence.
4. Together, We Will Guide You to a Fulfilling Journey – We aim to make every child’s time at St. Marks fulfilling and rewarding. Through diverse experiences and opportunities, we help children discover their passions and reach their full potential.
5. Together, We Will Help You Grow in Confidence – Our goal is to nurture each child’s self-esteem and confidence. By celebrating achievements and encouraging a growth mindset, we empower children to believe in themselves and their abilities.
With our diverse and inclusive community, we are committed to making these promises a reality for every child at St. Marks. We believe that by living out our vision, we can provide a guiding light that helps each child shine brightly and reach their full potential. Welcome to St. Marks, where our vision guides everything we do to help every child grow, learn, and succeed.

Home Learning and Support at St. Mark’s Primary School
At St. Mark’s Primary School in Islington, we believe that learning extends beyond the classroom, and parents play a crucial role in their child’s educational journey. Our website is a valuable resource, designed to empower parents with the tools and support they need to aid their child’s learning at home.
Here, you will find a wealth of information, including engaging learning activities, helpful tips, and links to online resources tailored for each year group. From phonics and reading support to math games and creative projects, our aim is to provide a well-rounded approach to learning that fosters curiosity and a love for education.
Additionally, St. Mark’s offers fantastic services to enrich your child’s learning experience. Our dedicated staff, including specialist teachers and support staff, are here to guide you and your child every step of the way. We encourage you to explore our website and connect with us, as together we can nurture your child’s potential and ensure they thrive academically and personally. Thank you for being an integral part of our school community!

Remote Learning at St. Mark’s Primary School
At St. Mark’s Primary School, our priority is to deliver high-quality, in-person education for all our pupils. We believe that face-to-face teaching offers the best opportunities for learning and development. While we do not currently use remote learning as part of our standard curriculum, we are fully prepared to implement remote education if circumstances require it.
In the event of a school closure or the need for individual pupils to remain at home due to illness or public health advice, we have the resources and infrastructure in place to ensure continuity of education. Our remote learning provision is designed to align with the curriculum taught in school, ensuring that pupils can continue progressing academically with structured support. We use a blend of online resources, interactive platforms, and tailored materials to suit the needs of all learners, including those with SEND.
St. Mark’s is committed to maintaining high standards of education, whether delivered in person or remotely, ensuring that every child has access to the tools and guidance needed to thrive, regardless of the learning environment.

pageCache.pageTitle: Music - St Mark's C of E Primary School
pageCache.text:
Music
Ethos and Curriculum Categories
At St Mark’s, we believe that all children should have the opportunity to experience, achieve and enjoy the subject of music. Learning and teaching in music is not only based around the national curriculum but also forms part of our whole school cross–curricular approach to learning and teaching.
At St Mark’s we believe very much in providing a rich and enjoyable Music education for all our pupils from EYFS to Year 6. Music is taught once a week by a specialist music teacher, Mr Allinson. We also have a visiting Woodwind tutor who leads recorder and clarinet teaching for our Year 4 class.
Music is fantastic for our pupil’s well-being and a highlight of being at St Mark’s.
A high quality music education inspires pupils to develop a love of music and their talent as musicians, and so increase their self-confidence and creativity.
Through responding to and playing a wide range of music/instruments, the children are helped to understand how sounds are made, changed and organised. The children develop an understanding of musical processes including learning about and reading relevant musical symbols and notation. The children understand how music is influenced by history, time and place of origin.
The teaching of music at St Mark’s develops skills and attitudes which can support learning in other curriculum areas e.g. listening skills, concentration levels, perseverance, self-confidence, creativity, respect and sensitivity towards others.
There are opportunities to work on projects at home with parents and carers, and celebrations of music in school to share children’s achievements and learning.

Supporting Your Child at St. Mark’s
Here, you’ll find a range of helpful links, tips, and resources to support your child’s education at St. Mark’s Primary School. Whether it’s phonics, maths, or creative activities, these tools are designed to enhance learning both in school and at home.
We believe that parents play a vital role in their child’s development. That’s why we’ve made it easy to access materials that will help you stay engaged and informed every step of the way.
Together, we can ensure your child reaches their full potential, building a strong foundation for their future success.
Staying Safe Online – A Guide for Parents- Think Smart
At St. Mark’s Primary School, we take online safety seriously and ensure that our children develop the knowledge and skills needed to navigate the digital world safely. We follow the Islington Computing Scheme, which teaches children about online risks, digital responsibility, and how to protect themselves when using technology. Additionally, we use LGfL’s online filtering and firewall to keep children safe while using the internet at school.
Managing Screen Time & App Use
In today’s digital world, children have access to a wide range of apps and online platforms. While technology is a valuable learning tool, excessive screen time can affect well-being, sleep, and concentration. We encourage parents to set clear boundaries for device use, use parental controls, and have open conversations about safe and appropriate app use.
Here are some tips for managing screen time and app safety at home:
✅ Set time limits for screen use, especially before bedtime. ✅ Use parental controls to manage app downloads and privacy settings. ✅ Encourage regular screen breaks and offline activities. ✅ Discuss online safety rules, including not sharing personal information. ✅ Check age ratings and content on apps, games, and social media.
To help parents support their children in staying safe online, we recommend the following trusted resources:
🔹LGfL Online Safety Hub – www.lgfl.net/online-safety 🔹 ThinkUKnow (CEOP) – Age-appropriate guidance for children and parents: www.thinkuknow.co.uk 🔹 Internet Matters – Expert advice and guides for parents: www.internetmatters.org 🔹 NSPCC Online Safety – Tips on setting parental controls and talking to children about online risks: www.nspcc.org.uk/keeping-children-safe/online-safety/🔹 Childnet – Resources on gaming, social media, and cyberbullying: www.childnet.com
🔹Common Sense Media Ultimate Parent Guide – www.commonsensemedia.org/parents-ultimate-guides
We encourage all parents to have regular conversations with their children about online safety, set parental controls on devices, and monitor their child’s internet use. If you have any concerns or need further support, please speak to your child’s teacher.
Together, we can create a safe and positive online experience for our children!

School Dinners
School Information Categories
For children to grow and develop, to learn and play, they need healthy meals and snacks.
At St Mark’s we help children to become independent by teaching them to make healthy food choices.
Free School Meals for Pupils in Reception and Key Stage 1
Children in Nursery and Reception and the Key Stage 1 classes are all entitled to Free School Meals under the Government initiative.
Parents do not have to pay for the meals and it is an ideal opportunity to take advantage of a healthy tasty hot meal at school.
Free School Meals and Pupil Premium
If any parents think their children may be entitled to free school meals please contact the school office for further details. Even if your child is in Recpetion class, Key Stage 1 and having a school meal free or your child is in Nursery or Key Stage 2 and does not wish to take school meals, if eligible, the information will gain welcome additional funding for the school known as ‘Pupil Premium’.
If you prefer your child may have a packed lunch. We ask that you ensure packed lunches are healthy and well balanced as we do encourage healthy eating throughout the school. The school is also a nut free school, therefore we ask you to check carefully and avoid nut products, all sweets, chocolates and fizzy drinks. Please ensure drinks are in a non-breakable container.
Fruit for Schools Initiative
All children in the Early Years and Key Stage 1, receive a free piece of fruit or vegetable for snack at playtime as part of the Government’s scheme to promote healthy eating. Please let us know if your child has any allergies to any particular types of fruit.
Unfortunately children in Key Stage 2 do not receive free fruit or vegetables, so they may wish to bring a snack to school each day. Please send fruit, peeled vegetables or dried fruit. Please do not send biscuits, chocolate, sweets, crisps, nuts etc.
Please note menu is subject to change.

The Importance of Phonics in Early Years Reading and Development
At St Mark’s, we believe that a strong foundation in phonics is crucial for your child’s reading and language development. Phonics equips children with the tools they need to decode words, understand their meaning, and develop fluency in reading. By mastering phonics, children gain the confidence to become independent readers, which opens the door to lifelong learning.
We are proud to use the FFT Success for All phonics programme. This structured, evidence-based approach ensures that every child builds essential reading skills at their own pace, leading to successful literacy outcomes. Success for All is designed to be engaging and accessible for all learners, helping to boost their progress in both reading and writing.
As always, we encourage open communication with parents. If you have any questions or would like further guidance on how you can support your child’s reading at home, feel free to speak to your class teacher at any time.
Additionally, we offer access to online decodable books, which your child can use to practise their phonics skills. You can obtain the necessary login code from your child’s class teacher, and the link to the resources is available below.
Together, we can ensure your child enjoys a bright start to their reading journey!

Ping: Our Primary Method of School Communication
At St. Mark’s Primary School, we believe clear and timely communication is key to supporting our students and their families. To ensure that all parents and carers receive important updates, reminders, and notices, we use Ping as our primary method of communication.
Why Ping?
Ping is a quick and efficient way for the school to keep you informed. Whether it’s an urgent notice, a reminder about an upcoming event, or a change in school scheduling, you’ll receive the information straight to your phone or device. By using Ping, we can make sure everyone stays up-to-date and involved in school life.
Sign Up Today!
We encourage all parents to make sure they are signed up for Ping. Important notices—such as school closures, event cancellations, and other time-sensitive updates—are sent directly through Ping, so it’s vital that you have access to this information.
Need Help?
If you are not yet signed up or are having difficulty using Ping, please don’t hesitate to contact the school office. Our staff are happy to assist you in getting set up and ensuring that you don’t miss any important communications.
Thank you for your continued support in staying connected with us. Together, we can ensure smooth communication and a stronger school community!
